overview: You wrote the vow by the moon, the line that tips the fruit-tree tops, and under it her refusal to swear by the moon. You did not let the vow stand unanswered on the sheet.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote both lines, and left the refusal standing.

assets.name: the orchard scene
assets.disposition: Wrote the vow by the moon and her answer under it
